proposed_exact_first_release_allowlist.rationale: Four concrete adapter/coordinator sites need shape or authority changes. No existing tests need edit to preserve their old scalar literals. central_contract.name: photo_semantic_evidence._resolve_selected_native_contracts(entries, core, ...)
central_contract.authority: Only this coordinator reads and validates source proofs, exact selected source conditions, references, profiles and member dependencies. B1 accepts a fresh private projection from this coordinator, never a serialized composed projection or caller resolution view. No allowed/qualified flag is added to B1.
central_contract.full_source: Full source must pass native.validate with its actual current corpus/catalog and complete positive unit/quote/application/reference closure, then normal compact sealing. Ordinary full retrieval entry already follows this via corpus.entry -> compact -> validate. A new scope path must not treat a raw self-attested proof dictionary without that context as source-qualified.
central_contract.compact_source: On already validated pinned layout compact, check compact seal, actual effect equality and source-local coverage, exact CID/RID/qualification/meaning/reference, dependency guard/child/proof/RID seals and frame provenance. Do not demand absent quote text or compact a compact child again. Final compose rebuilds from pinned full source and revalidates it.
algorithm: Reconstruct exactly the chosen roots and required/explicitly selected optional edges in source order, retaining every incoming member/presentation condition and selected actual RID. Reject foreign/unused selection entries, conflicting shared source/RID/owner bindings and missing children. No optional-all default.

Validate original source-local assignment consistency and exact full actual E coverage before expansion, then build normalized B1 node bodies from selected facts minus source quote fields, normalized map selections and exact additional own-sealed guard targets. Build child projection hashes bottom-up and root/selected closure; never trust a caller projection_sha256.

Choose explicit fixed_point_witness_context only for old fixed/introduced scalar contexts with absent hash. Any supplied canonical hash must be valid; generic selected point/scope requires exact core-bound context. Scope additionally pins full input/provenance, graph, table and whole selected scope row. Missing hash is never bad-hash fallback.

Call B1 resolve_selected_contracts once for the complete operation; share that exact result with P/PR matching, actual guards, E joint assignment, receiver footprint, preservation and final audit. Internal reuse is bounded to one audit with exact core/projection equality; no stored cross-run cache authority.
central_contract.closure_vs_active_subtree: The resolver view includes all chosen roots and actual children for joint E checks. A consumer asking for one selected materialized child uses that node plus its actual descendant closure, not unrelated sibling/root effects. Filter the already expanded node facts; do not rerun owner/member expansion. Preserve each parent incoming guard even for a shared child.
central_contract.no_recursion: Projection and permission-footprint computation never call admission/guard evaluation. Guard preservation reads the already computed whole footprint. Strict permission may request guard admission, but pure expansion cannot recurse back into it.

five_duplicate_loops_to_replace.replace: Use B1 tagged bindings. Old point-only adapter extracts raw owner dictionary and exact selected-point binding receipt from members of bindings proven point-only; scope extraction rejects rather than index0/list coercion. No graph role lookup/owner resolution remains in this adapter.

Use the complete B1 effect_assignments and conflict validation across actual chosen roots/closure. Preserve source-local check. P/PR old values excluded from E conflicts; exact type/value/operation/canonical receiverSET, part_of distinct and introduced synthetic addresses unchanged.

Use B1 expanded node facts and permission_scope. Canonical properties and raw literal_properties are projections of the same expansions. A subtree view only selects already-resolved facts; all E targets and ALL actual receiver members remain. Unknown alias overlap still denied by unchanged photo_contracts.

When record is source-addressed, resolve its actual selected root/closure then feed complete raw/canonical actual footprint to unchanged lock API. Calls already supplying actual property triples with record=None remain actual and are not remapped. Make this distinction explicit internally; no owners.get(target,target) fallback for a scope and no double mapping actual IDs.

Use shared B1 point/scope binding rows. v1 raw-role behavior stays exactly raw, v2 scalar endpoints remain point-only. New explicit quantifier binds each stored member from that same shared view; evaluator performs predicate truth/frame provenance only, no independent member traversal.

proposed_opt_in_shapes.proof: Keep top photo-candidate-role-evidence/v4 and fact/source-unit shapes. Old v2/v3 owner maps, v1 request selections, v1/v2 guards and absent optional support fields retain literal meaning and bytes.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.owner_map: photo-native-owner-bindings/v4, same bindings envelope. Keep explicit core_role / selected_existing_owner selector forms; new existing-only selected_existing_member_scope selector contains scope_schema=photo-frozen-existing-member-scope/v1,target_semantics=each_member,receiver_semantics=all_members. No source member list, default scope, count or introduced_by value.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.request: photo-request-owner-selections/v2 for scope compositions: exact core_sha256/owner_graph_sha256/member_scopes_sha256/entries. Each entry exact CID/RID/meaning/qualification; binding {target,selection:{kind:existing_owner,owner_id}} or {target,selection:{kind:existing_member_scope,scope_id,scope_sha256}}. One whole mapping covers scope and scalar chosen nodes, all used entries required, extras denied. Old requestv1 remains unchanged for old point compositions. No second scope-selection parameter.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.descriptor: photo-owner-selection-requirements/v2 only where new scope choice exists, preserving each required source target kind, actual RID, meaning/qualification and dependency adoption mode. No selected core scope or member array is written into retrieval pack. Old point-only descriptors/v1 remain byte-identical.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.guards: photo-native-source-guards/v3: explicit for_each_member rule {id,kind,scope:{kind:source_target,candidate_id,target},member_variable,rule:<one scalar atomic predicate>}. A bound_member endpoint names only the one lexically bound variable. Inner scalar predicate kinds: owner_relation/frozen_value/frozen_entity_relation/preserve_established_scope. Non-bound endpoints remain exact source_target point endpoints. No nested quantifier, existential/OR/cartesian/count, implicit lifting of v1/v2 guards or role inference.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.guard_receipt: Each quantified result pins declaring/activation CID and actual RID, sealed common/branch/member/presentation frame, condition/rule hashes, exact scope target/CID, scope table/row/assertion/member index+span/input provenance, actual raw+canonical owner, scalar rule result and exact frozen assertion witness. All members required; one missing/false/unknown member denies after selection. Unselected scope only review/search-only, not verified.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.guard_role_coordination: Current guard_supports/v1 supports prerequisite owner_relation/frozen_entity_relation on v1/v2 source blocks only. Do not silently interpret it as evidence for a new quantified block or create new roles from guard success. Agree an explicit opt-in quantified support shape with root/role-view worker before accepting guard-only v3 role evidence; until that shape is approved, relation-only sources needing it remain unqualified rather than borrowed into scalar support. Ordinary independently authored P/E roles can coexist with v3 constraint guards. Other worker pure role-view module remains untouched.
proposed_opt_in_shapes.resolution: Scope adoption emits optional auditor photo-native-owner-resolution/v2 containing existing pack/composed/core/selection binding plus scope/input pins, normalized projection/whole expanded ledger hashes, actual selected closure and per-member P/PR/quantified guard witnesses. Never accept resolution as composed input. Old scalar v1 resolution and old admission receipts remain exact through point-only adapters; no new default fields.

P_PR_guard_permission_rules: For EACH expanded prerequisite/preservation target, match exactly one actual frozen fact at same canonical entity, exact dimension/property/type/value; frozen reference preservation only may bind same frozen value. Parent/part presence or another member cannot satisfy it. Preserve actual core assertion ID and member provenance. Context is not P and cannot waive an E.

Guard-only owner/scope targets may be introduced into only their own sealed source common/branch binding inventory. Member/presentation frames cannot inject a parent/other child owner plan. Required child and selected optional namespaces remain exact; unselected optional child contributes no facts/guards/footprint.

Existing member scopes are closed caller-authored inventories, not fake entities. No count derived from cardinality, no new people/hands/items, no material/anatomy inference from owner_kind/roles/labels; generic presence is not face/skin/hand evidence and body.parts equality remains exact.

Collective E belongs to separately real wearer/image/scene point and all declared receiver members; uniform each-member E is a distinct manually authored source interpretation. Do not copy a collective target value onto its receivers. Scope never adds/removes members.

Explicit equivalence canonicalizes assignment identity; part_of is not equivalence. Receiver locks and property/dimension locks cover all actual members and aliases, including equal-value E on a locked property. Unknown overlap denies. P old to E new remains legal only if actual property permission is open.

Tampered source/quote/role/spec/qualification/reference/compact hash rejects before projection; caller self-hashed projection cannot enter public admission API.

One missing/wrong typed fact, parent-only presence, unknown input, stale scope and introduced member reject. No-scope old scalar and v1 guard literal expectations stay byte-identical.

For-each owned-member part_of and frozen entity RHS relation to same explicit point; false last member, wrong scope CID/frame/variable/actual RID/member index/hash, sibling injection, optional unselected endpoints and introduced endpoints deny. Collective point E with all member receivers versus each-member E; hidden last-member receiver lock, equal E frozen property, overlapping scopes with conflicting typed value/type/op/receiverSET across independent roots and selected required children reject. Pold/Enew, disjoint different owners/properties and canonical receiver alias controls pass.

Required/selected optional/unselected optional/shared child and profile branches: actual chosen closure only, all incoming guards, distinct owner maps, unused mapping deny, conflicting shared RID deny. No double compact of lazy child or flattening all alternatives.

Actual temp fixture lazy retrieval -> one immutable pack -> composed owner_selections -> full compose audit -> stored optional resolution/v2 -> fresh runtime equality. Missing choice discovery search-only/final deny; malformed/stale supplied choice deny, failed audit correction allowed, success rebind/stale composed mapping/receipt deny.
